findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration or bucket policy requiring encrypted uploads. Objects such as the customer master spreadsheet are therefore not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.

This financial-data bucket does not configure default server-side encryption or require encryption on object uploads, leaving sensitive stored data without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.

The operations bucket lacks a default server-side encryption configuration and does not enforce encrypted object uploads. Data placed in the bucket is not governed by an explicit encryption-at-rest requirement.

Although this bucket has versioning and access logging, it does not configure default server-side encryption or enforce encryption for uploads. Data-science data can be stored without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
